hooks.name: Create Testing Scenario on Task Completion
hooks.description: Ensures every completed spec task produces a corresponding testing scenario document in .kiro/docs/scenarios/

action.prompt: After completing this spec task, you MUST create a testing scenario document at `.kiro/docs/scenarios/{spec-name}-testing.md` (if one does not already exist for this spec). The scenario file should describe step-by-step manual testing instructions covering the feature that was just implemented, including: prerequisites, happy path scenarios, edge cases, expected results, a verification checklist table, and relevant database queries for manual inspection. Follow the format and style of existing files in `.kiro/docs/scenarios/`.
